## Interactive JS Editor

```{=html}
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: sans-serif;
      margin: 2rem;
    }
    /* Style the editor container */
    #editor-container {
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 6px;
      overflow: hidden;
      max-width: 600px;
    }
    /* Give the CM editor a default height */
    .cm-editor {
      height: 300px;
    }
  </style>


  <h2>CodeMirror 6 Live Demo</h2>
  <div id="editor-container"></div>

  <!-- Load CodeMirror 6 natively via ESM CDN -->
  <script type="module">
    import { EditorView, basicSetup } from "https://esm.sh/codemirror";
    import { javascript } from "https://esm.sh/@codemirror/lang-javascript";

    const view = new EditorView({
      doc: "// You are running CodeMirror 6 live!\nfunction test() {\n  return true;\n}",
      extensions: [
        basicSetup,
        javascript()
      ],
      parent: document.querySelector("#editor-container")
    });
  </script>

```
